GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 6 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
Jumped Ok eased to last 8+ Lengths off, well back turn, Straightened Up well off, worked home ok with limited room late # good 4 further
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the outside barrier was shifted behind runners in the early stages of the event. Passing the 50m had to be shifted out from the heels of runner, which was weakening, to continue into clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Worked fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (1L from lead) early . Worked to improve 1 length to =lead 3 Wide midrace & Two Wide @ 700m. Pushed to hold ground @ 550m. Pushed along 3 Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Weakened 3 Wide in straight. # Worked & weakened
Jumped Well Went Forward Outside Leader .5 Lengths 1200m took sit 3rd 2 Lengths 800m 3rd 2 Lengths home turn Hooked Out 3 Wide 2nd weakened final 150m # every ch/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down outside leader. 2nd turn. battled on well # Every Chance

Debut for stable. Began OK. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide early . Worked to hold ground but back 1 length midrace & improving again from 550m. Pushed to quicken =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & challenged leaders @ 150m. Boxed on until faded late. # Worked/stuck on OK
Jumped Ok Settled Down 5th 4 lengths. under pressure turn 5 lengths. weakened. Every Chance # Ordinary Effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that the gelding travelled comfortably throughout the event, however, was disappointing in its finishing efforts. He added that in his opinion, the gelding did not appreciate the step up in distance and may have come to the end of its preparation. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well landed box seat 1-2l off, saved ground turn, Straightened Up 1 length off clear rails run, running on half off passing 200m, loomed up 100m, 2 horse battle to the line, got upper hand very late # box seat/did enough
Bit Slow Out 1 length bustled, settled 3-4l off but 3 wide, gave ground turn, Straightened Up well off, battled on well after tough run # 3 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three-wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 12 lengths. well back turn hooking wide. made some ground # too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Hung in through the early stages and then began to over-race for some time after.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1/2 length went through to settle Mid Field 3 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 1 length. got clear late # too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a pre-race veterinary examination after racing on Friday 3 January and was passed suitable to race.
